bullets.text: Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to rectify the train-platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor the progress.
The Home Department transferred four police officers, including Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran, and the office should note the administrative change.
Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja along with other narcotics, and the office should acknowledge their anti-drug enforcement action.
The University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should support this educational partnership.
LiveX introduced human-like AI hosts powered by NVIDIA technology to provide conversational assistance in public venues, and the office should watch this digital innovation.

stories.title: Train-platform gap yet to be rectified at Adambakkam
takeaways: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix platform gaps at Adambakkam station.
Commuter safety concerns persist until the railway platform modifications are completed.

The technology highlights global innovations in practical AI integration that can inspire local governance strategies.
